Class OrdersRest

java.lang.Object
jakarta.servlet.GenericServlet
jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServlet
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.servlet.RestServlet
org.apache.juneau.rest.server.servlet.BasicRestServlet
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.PetstoreConsolePage
org.apache.juneau.petstore.console.orders.OrdersRest
All Implemented Interfaces:
jakarta.servlet.Servlet, jakarta.servlet.ServletConfig, Serializable, BasicUniversalConfig, DefaultConfig, DefaultHtmlConfig
public class OrdersRest extends PetstoreConsolePage
The Orders page and its endpoints: the server-mode datatable query over BeanQuery, the approve and deliver status transitions, and the cancel dialog form with its DELETE.
Example:

// PLACED to APPROVED; any other status is a 409. @RestPost(path="/{id}/approve") public ActionResult approve(RestRequest req, @Path("id") long id) { return transition(req, id, "approve", OrderStatus.PLACED, OrderStatus.APPROVED); }

<@card type="datatables" id="orders"> { dataMode:'server', dataUrl:'/console/orders/query', rowActions:[{id:'approve', endpoint:'/console/orders/{id}/approve', method:'POST'}] } </@card>

    • query

      public DataTablesResults<Order> query(@Content DataTablesRequest req, @Query("day") @Schema(aev=true) String day, @Query("start") @Schema(aev=true) String start, @Query("end") @Schema(aev=true) String end)
      Server-mode DataTables query over all orders.

      The optional day query parameter (yyyy-mm-dd) narrows the orders to those whose ship date falls in that day's window, before the request's own column filters apply, so the two combine. A missing, blank or malformed value is ignored.

      The optional start and end query parameters (the window URL-state directive's defaults; each a yyyy-mm-dd date or an ISO date-time, whose calendar date is used) keep the orders whose ship date falls between them, both days included, and either may be given alone. A bound that is blank or malformed is ignored. An order with no readable ship date is outside any window that has a usable bound. The window and day combine with each other and with the request's own column filters.

      Parameters:
      req - The DataTables request.
      day - The day to keep, or null.
      start - The first ship day to keep, or null.
      end - The last ship day to keep, or null.
      Returns:
      One page of orders, or a 200 error envelope for a malformed search expression.

    • newForm

      public ModalDef newForm()
      The new-order wizard, step one: pick a pet that is for sale and an optional ship date.

      The review button opens the stacked second step and carries these inputs to it as drafts. That step's Confirm posts to /console/orders, as declared on the child action.

      Returns:
      The modal, on the compact chrome.

      The new-order wizard, step two: the order about to be placed, read back from the first step's drafts.
      Parameters:
